counterexample_boundary: functional of means replaces the sample-wise pushforward
ratio of means replaces mean of sample-wise ratios
missing samples are imputed without a declared rule
rows.sampling_law: sealed source draws with one deterministic functional
rows.source_statement: Certified sample-wise F pushforward

rows.adjudicated_statement: Cov(X_a-X_b)=C_aa+C_bb-C_ab-C_ba. Omitting cross-covariance changes the reported covariance from C_actual to C_omitted=C_aa+C_bb, so C_omitted-C_actual=C_ab+C_ba (equivalently C_actual-C_omitted=-(C_ab+C_ba)). It is never a paired calculation.
assumptions: paired depths refer to the same observational unit
covariance blocks are finite and dimension-compatible
counterexample_boundary: independent marginals are relabelled as paired observations
one ordered cross-covariance block is omitted
covariance_assumptions: all four covariance blocks share one feature basis
rows.sampling_law: joint finite-second-moment law for a paired feature vector
rows.source_statement: Paired depth-contrast covariance

rows.adjudicated_statement: The finite nested depth/mask path uses a maximum statistic calibrated from the same centered-null path. No exact continuum-path statement follows.
assumptions: all rungs report one centered target on a nested finite path
maximum-statistic null calibration uses an independent split
counterexample_boundary: nonnested or differently centered depth paths are refused
finite-path calibration does not cover a continuum of masks
rows.sampling_law: independent equicorrelated finite depth-path null splits
rows.source_statement: ZoA finite-path morphology test

rows.adjudicated_statement: The perturbation bound scales as inverse minimum whitened singular value. A full-rank cell below either frozen floor abstains.
assumptions: response whitening uses the registered covariance
rank, singular-value, principal-angle, and perturbation floors are fixed
counterexample_boundary: full rank below the frozen singular-value or angle floor abstains
a wrong covariance identity is refused
rows.source_statement: Weak-identification error bound

rows.adjudicated_statement: Rank of a registered orbit-chart/response composition is checked for one declared linear cell. It does not establish global orbit separation.
assumptions: orbit chart and supported response share one declared linear cell
the rank tolerance is fixed before evaluation
counterexample_boundary: one registered linear cell is not global orbit separation
rank loss in either factor kills composition identifiability
rows.source_statement: Orbit-response composition identifiability

rows.adjudicated_statement: Power is a registered synthetic matched-counterpair property and does not identify a physical family.
assumptions: scalar and anchor coordinates are exactly matched
morphology summaries use the frozen modes and held-out split
counterexample_boundary: power is conditional on the registered synthetic counterpair
scalar or anchor mismatch invalidates the counterpair
rows.sampling_law: registered synthetic matched-counterpair null and alternative laws
rows.source_statement: Matched-counterpair morphology power

rows.adjudicated_statement: Coverage and abstention are finite-library synthetic diagnostics with a frozen calibration/evaluation split.
assumptions: known centres, unknown generator, threshold, and split are frozen
finite-library removal sensitivity is reported
counterexample_boundary: unknown cases abstain rather than receive a nearest family label
rows.sampling_law: registered finite known-library and unknown-generator laws
rows.source_statement: Open-set type-report abstention and coverage

rows.adjudicated_statement: The adapter is validated on a declared synthetic depth covariance and mask path. The source remains a program obligation pending admitted data.
assumptions: depth covariance, local/global designs, and mask path are explicit
HTT owns GLS while MIO receives residual diagnostics only
counterexample_boundary: the adapter remains synthetic pending admitted data
MIO residual diagnostics do not contain likelihood or posterior
rows.sampling_law: registered synthetic Gaussian depth-covariance local/global laws
rows.source_statement: Depth-conditioned local-global discrimination
